points.description: The training data is labelled with two classes, positive and negative (+/-).
The weights are initialized (randomly or to arbitrary starting values).

For each training point x(n), the weights are updated by adding eta*x(n) (eta is the learning rate) when the point is misclassified, i.e. when <w,x> <= 0 for a positive point (or >= 0 for a negative point).
The update step is repeated over the training data for many epochs until the weights stop changing much.
The algorithm converges because the data is linearly separable.
